gloss: every night; nightly; night after night

definitions.gloss: every night; nightly; night after night
definitions.explanation: Happening repeatedly each night. A somewhat literary or poetic term for expressing that something occurs on a nightly basis.

examples.japanese: {夜毎|よごと}{夢|ゆめ}を{見|み}る。
{夜毎|よごと}の{宴|うたげ}に{明|あ}け{暮|く}れる。
examples.english: To spend one's days absorbed in nightly banquets.

examples.japanese: {夜毎|よごと}{繁華街|はんかがい}に{繰|く}り{出|だ}す{若者|わかもの}たちが{後|あと}を{絶|た}たない。
examples.english: There is no end to the young people who head out to the entertainment district night after night.

notes:
A literary/poetic adverb formed from {夜|よ} (night) + {毎|ごと} (every). More evocative and literary than {毎晩|まいばん} (every evening).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夜毎|よごと}の{夢|ゆめ}: nightly dreams
- {夜毎|よごと}の{宴|うたげ}: nightly feasts/parties
- {夜毎|よごと}{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す: to repeat night after night

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {毎晩|まいばん}: every evening/night — the standard, everyday term
- {毎夜|まいよ}: every night — slightly formal, between {夜毎|よごと} and {毎晩|まいばん}
- {日毎|ひごと}: every day; day by day — the daytime counterpart

REGISTER:
Slightly literary and poetic. Used in written language, narratives, and formal descriptions more than in casual conversation.
